name: math.settings
title: Math Settings
description: The declaration to configure the math and calculator apps.

payloadkeys.title: Calculator
payloadkeys.content: If present, configures the built-in Calculator app.

subkeys.title: Basic mode
subkeys.content: If present, configures the basic mode of the calculator. Basic mode is always enabled.

subkeys.title: Add square root
subkeys.content: Add the square root button to the basic calculator by replacing the +/- button. Normally, the square root button is available in scientific mode, so this key can be used to make it available when the scientific mode is restricted.

subkeys.title: Scientific mode
subkeys.content: If present, configures the scientific mode of the calculator. If not present, scientific mode is enabled.

subkeys.title: Enabled
subkeys.content: Controls whether the mode is enabled.

subkeys.title: Programmer mode
subkeys.content: If present, configures the programmer mode of the calculator. If not present, programmer mode is enabled.

subkeys.title: Enabled
subkeys.content: Controls whether the mode is enabled.

subkeys.title: Math notes mode
subkeys.content: If present, configures the Math Notes mode of the calculator. If not present, Math Notes mode is enabled.

subkeys.title: Enabled
subkeys.content: Controls whether the mode is enabled.

subkeys.title: Input modes
subkeys.content: If present, controls global input options of the calculator. If not present, all input modes are enabled.

subkeys.title: Unit conversion
subkeys.content: Configures whether unit conversions are enabled.

subkeys.title: RPN
subkeys.content: Configures whether RPN input is enabled.

payloadkeys.title: System behavior
payloadkeys.content: If present, configures math behavior in the system.

subkeys.title: Keyboard suggestions
subkeys.content: Controls whether keyboard suggestions include math solutions. This key is also supported by the keyboard.settings configuration.

subkeys.title: Math notes
subkeys.content: Controls whether Math Notes is allowed in other apps such as Notes.
